rationale: The FAA's 'Roadmap for Artificial Intelligence Safety Assurance, Version I' explicitly states that 'Learned AI Implementation' (defined as static in the operating environment) is 'subjected to design time safety assurance processes prior to its use in an operational context.' It further clarifies that 'each new version is subjected to safety assurance,' directly supporting both parts of the claim. The source's nature as a roadmap aligns with the claim's stated scope and provisional status.
evidence_locators: PDF physical p. 11 / printed p. 10, learned AI implementation and update discussion
